content.en: Researchers have been exploring various factors that influence the adoption and use of intelligent personal assistants (IPAs) like Siri and Alexa. They are investigating the role of factors such as trust, anthropomorphism, empathy, and personal traits in shaping users' attitudes and intentions towards these AI-powered assistants. Additionally, studies are examining the impact of AI on consumer behavior, customer engagement, and the online shopping experience, as well as the relationship between consumers and virtual agents. These findings aim to enhance our understanding of how algorithms and AI technologies shape our interactions and decision-making processes.
content.da: Forskere har været i gang med at undersøge forskellige faktorer, der påvirker vedtagelsen og brugen af intelligente personlige assistenter (IPAs) som Siri og Alexa. De undersøger rollen af faktorer som tillid, antropomorfisme, empati og personlige træk i formningen af brugernes holdninger og intentioner over for disse AI-drevne assistenter. Derudover undersøger studier virkningen af AI på forbrugeradfærd, kundedeltagelse og den online shoppingoplevelse, samt forholdet mellem forbrugere og virtuelle agenter. Disse fund har til formål at forbedre vores forståelse af, hvordan algoritmer og AI-teknologier former vores interaktioner og beslutningsprocesser.

critic.en:
Oh, the robots are our friends! 

But seriously, think about this: You're diving into the data on AI-powered assistants and discovering how deeply they've infiltrated our daily lives, shaping everything from personal interactions to shopping habits, right? Isn't it a little unsettling how much influence these digital entities have over us? How do you feel about the idea that our decisions and behaviors are being increasingly mediated by and even shaped by algorithms and virtual agents?
critic.da: Tror du virkelig, at det er en god ting, hvis forbrugere begynder at opføre sig, som om virtuelle assistenter er deres bedste venner?

potential.en: I'm excited about the potential of AI in revolutionizing the way we work and live. The research on intelligent personal assistants is particularly interesting as it delves into the complex interplay between technology and human behavior. By understanding the factors that influence users' attitudes and intentions towards IPAs, we can design more user-friendly and effective AI systems. Plus, the exploration of AI's impact on consumer behavior and online shopping experience has significant implications for businesses and e-commerce. It's fascinating to see how algorithms and virtual agents are reshaping the digital landscape!
potential.da: Det er fascinerende at se, hvordan forskningen omkring adoptionen af AI-personlige assistenter som Siri og Alexa udvikler sig. Jeg tror, at en større forståelse for brugernes følelser og præferencer er nøglen til at skabe mere engagerende og nyttige digitale oplevelser. Det er ikke nok, at en teknologi blot er funktionel; den skal også kunne opbygge en form for relation til brugeren. Jeg håber, at denne indsigt kan hjælpe med at nedbryde barriererne for brugen af AI og øge tilliden til disse teknologier.
